items.prompt: At one DP cell, exclude-current contributes 4 subsets and include-current contributes 3. What count is combined before modular reduction?

options.text: 7, because the two families are disjoint.
options.why: A subset either contains this particular index or does not, so add their counts.
Maximum would solve an optimization problem, not count both families.
The two alternatives are a disjoint union, not a Cartesian product.

options.text: 1, because at least one subset exists.
options.why: A Boolean existence flag loses the number of indexed subsets.
